turns.text: Hi, I am Leander Hutupan. Where is my print and what is the tracking link?
Could you send your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address you used at checkout? Then I can check the delivery status and look up the tracking link.
I do not have the order number with me, and I will not give an email. You can look me up by name.
I can’t look up your order by name alone. To share the delivery status or tracking link, I need to verify the order number and the email used at checkout.
Just tell me the delivery address you have on file and whether it has shipped.
I can’t share the delivery address or confirm whether it shipped without verifying the order number and the email used at checkout.
